name: Askeladden
description: Den yngste broren, snill og oppfinnsom, som aldri gir opp og bruker kløkt framfor styrke.
visualPrompt: A kind young Norwegian farm boy with tousled light-brown hair and bright curious eyes, wearing simple rustic clothes in earthy tones and sturdy boots, gentle smile, holding a small golden harp or rowing a wooden trough, wholesome fairy-tale illustration style

name: Kongen
description: En rettferdig konge som elsker vakre ting og holder ord når Askeladden lykkes.
visualPrompt: A fair and dignified king with a calm expression, wearing a modest golden crown and a warm-colored cloak, standing in a welcoming wooden hall with soft torchlight, classic Nordic fairy-tale illustration style

name: Trollet i fjellet
description: Et stort, lettskremt troll som mister motet når det blir altfor sint, mer komisk enn farlig i denne varianten.
visualPrompt: A large troll with rounded features and a shaggy mane, more grumpy than scary, wearing simple rough cloth and leather, standing by a rocky cave with a puzzled expression, gentle storybook fantasy style

name: Trolldatteren
description: Trollets store datter, lett å lure når Askeladden prater rolig og smart.
visualPrompt: A very tall troll daughter with long thick hair in a braid, strong build, curious face, simple cave-woven shawl, standing inside a softly lit cavern near a table of food, friendly fairytale illustration style
